entries.text: Rex made the first leaf bed.
Ket brought down the first hopper: fresh meat.
Zean saw a seed come up where food had rotted, and understood. They watched it happen.
Bral was born to Rex and Bal.
Chool was born to Chob and Zean.
Zean built the first drying rack.
Ne saw that a hopper will stay where it is fed, and understood. They worked it out with their own hands.
Zean worked a hide until it stayed soft. They watched it happen.
The Hide age begins.
The village can now raise a hide teepee (hide stretched on poles): the design is in the Blueprints panel.
Cheak was born to Ne and Lair.
Lightning struck a tree 13 cells from the camp. It is burning.
Bal was first to keep a fire. They watched it happen.
The Hearth age dawns, behind the Hide age.
Bal built the first fire ring.
Ne lit the first hearth fire.
The burning tree has fallen in on itself and smoulders.
Bal was first to burn wood to black coal. They watched it happen.
Di was born to Bal and Rex.
Voom was born to Zean and Chob.
Sho was born to Ne and Lair.
Bral is known for singing: sings to the others at rest.
The first winter is over: 13 survive.
A whole winter passed and nobody died of cold.
Chool is known for carving: carves small figures from wood.
Ret was born to Chool and Ket.
